description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Magical Blink 2] and [Terminating Blade Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Magical Blink 2
description.text: Evades the next 2 non-PHY, non-NIN attack that deals magical, fractional or missing HP damage

description.name: Terminating Blade Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Terminating Blade after using three of Holy Cross Slash or Awaken
